bio.text: Diana Gonzales Worthen has represented District 9, covering East Springdale, in the Arkansas House of Representatives since her first term in the 95th General Assembly.
The House describes her as the first Latina legislator in Arkansas history, with more than 35 years of experience as an educator in public schools and higher education.

Gonzales Worthen holds a Ph.D. in curriculum and instruction from the University of Arkansas, a master's degree in teaching from the University of Texas at Dallas, and a biology degree from the University of Houston. She lives in Springdale.
